skills.name: Underworld Frenzy
skills.description: Passive: When any unit on the field falls, grants Hades souls. Deity units grant Hades 3 souls, and Minions grant Hades 1 soul. Hades can have up to 25 souls. Active: Hades leaps into a dense enemy area and summons Soul Storm within 5 meters around himself, entering a continuous casting state for 8 seconds. During this time, he continually moves toward dense enemy areas, gaining a 30% dodge rate, and deals DMG equal to 50% of ATK per second to surrounding units. 50% of the DMG dealt is converted into a Shield for himself. For every 1 soul he has, the DMG multiplier of Soul Storm increases by 7.5% of ATK.

upgrades.level2: Deals DMG equal to 80% of ATK per second to surrounding units.
upgrades.level3: 30% of the DMG dealt by Soul Storm is converted into Healing.
upgrades.level4: For every 1 soul he has, the DMG multiplier of Soul Storm increases by 15% of ATK.

skills.name: Abyssal Claws
skills.description: Swings the Soul Claw forward, dealing DMG equal to 300% of ATK to the farthest enemy unit and rooting them. After a short delay, retracts the Soul Claw, pulling the unit to the front of Hades.

upgrades.level2: Deals DMG equal to 400% of ATK to the farthest enemy unit.
upgrades.level3: The hit unit will also grant Hades 1 soul.
upgrades.level4: The hit unit will also grant Hades 3 souls.

skills.name: True Form Revealed
skills.description: After Hades falls, he transforms into [Underworld Divinity] until the end of the battle. [Underworld Divinity] is considered a Deity unit (1. Cannot be revived by Mengpo; 2. The battle will not end if only Underworld Divinity remains). Underworld Divinity: Inherits all stats and gains an additional 100% Max HP and 50% Physical & Magical Resistance, but cannot use Ultimate Skills.

upgrades.level2: Inherits all stats and gains an additional 120% Max HP.
upgrades.level3: Inherits all stats and gains an additional 140% Max HP.
upgrades.level4: Inherits all stats and gains an additional 160% Max HP.

skills.name: Truly Delectable
skills.description: Passive: When Hades absorbs a soul, he restores HP equal to 8% of ATK.

upgrades.level2: Each soul also grants him 5% ATK.
upgrades.level3: When Hades absorbs a soul, he restores HP equal to 15% of ATK.
upgrades.level4: Each soul also grants him 10% ATK.

relic.name: Underworld Throne
relic.description: Hades carries 5 souls upon entering the battle.

upgrades.level2: Underworld Divinity no longer casts any active skills, but gains a permanent Soul Storm effect.
upgrades.level3: When reaching 20 souls and Soul Storm is active, his DMG taken is reduced by a fixed amount equal to 60% ATK.
upgrades.level4: When any unit falls while Soul Storm is active: Emits a soul shockwave outward from the fallen unit, dealing DMG equal to 100% ATK + 10% of the fallen unit's Max HP to enemy units in a large area (not exceeding 800% of his own ATK).
